capsule.label: Outer bar capsule
capsule.description: Wrap the entire XMB strip in a Noctalia capsule. Keep disabled to use one pill per workspace.

target_output.label: Target output
target_output.description: Niri output whose workspaces this widget displays. Empty uses the bar output.

backend_command.label: Backend command
backend_command.description: niri-xmb executable or command prefix used for snapshots and actions.

hide_empty_workspaces.label: Hide empty workspaces
hide_empty_workspaces.description: Keep active workspaces visible while hiding other empty workspaces.

allow_drag.label: Enable drag and drop
allow_drag.description: Allow tiled windows to be rearranged and moved between workspaces.

allow_column_join.label: Join columns on icon drop
allow_column_join.description: Treat drops nearest a window as column joins instead of left/right insertion.

preserve_cursor_after_drag.label: Preserve cursor after drag
preserve_cursor_after_drag.description: Restore the pointer after niri-xmb temporarily focuses a moved window.

show_active_indicator.label: Active indicator
show_active_indicator.description: Show a primary-color line under the active workspace.

icon_size.label: Icon size
icon_size.description: Application icon size in logical pixels.

group_opacity.label: Inactive opacity
group_opacity.description: Opacity used for inactive workspace groups.
